title: Cobblemon Ditto HMs
description: Learn Ditto's 34 Pokopia HM abilities yourself — cut, fly, surf, teleport and more, fueled by hunger. A Cobblemon add-on for Fabric + NeoForge.
body:
# 🟣 Cobblemon Ditto HMs

**Become the HM slave you always made suffer.** Cobblemon Ditto HMs brings **34 Pokopia-inspired HM abilities** (24 active + 10 toggles) to any [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) world — you don't teach the moves to your Pokémon, **you learn them yourself**.

Works on **Fabric and NeoForge**, Minecraft **1.21.1**.

---

## 🧬 How it works

1. 🔍 **Find the right Pokémon** in the wild — every ability is taught by specific species.
2. 🤝 **Sneak + right-click** it while holding that ability's **trigger item**.
3. 💿 You receive an **HM Disc** — right-click it to learn the ability **permanently**.
4. 🎒 Craft the **HM Case** to manage everything from a single hotbar slot.

> 🤫 **Discovery is part of the game.** The mod never tells you which Pokémon teaches which HM or which item to hold — the acquisition tables live only in [the wiki](https://manucruzleiva.github.io/cobblemon-ditto-hms/). Spoil yourself, or don't!

## ⚡ Active HMs (24)

Right-click to unleash — each use costs **hunger** and starts a cooldown:

**Water Gun · Leafage · Cut · Rock Smash · Rototiller · Camouflage · Strength · Waterfall · Magnet Rise · Ember · Bullet Seed · Teleport · Fly · Rain Dance · Sunny Day · Rest · Dig · Explosion · Thunder · String Shot · Defog · Crabhammer · Revival Blessing · Charm**

Fell whole trees with Cut, vein-mine with Rock Smash, blink around with Teleport, call lightning with Thunder, revive your whole party with Revival Blessing — or go out with a bang with Explosion (you survive at 1 HP… usually).

## 🔄 Toggle HMs (10)

Passive abilities you switch on and off — each one **blocks part of your hunger bar** while enabled:

**Jump · Surf · Rollout · Dive · Flash · Rock Climb · Mean Look · Harden · Glide · Burning Bulwark**

Climb any wall, glide off mountains, breathe underwater, shrug off fire with a scorching thorns aura, or walk around in invisible diamond-grade armour. Every enabled toggle shows its own **HUD icon** so you always know what's running.

## 🎒 The HM Case

A craftable case that holds all your learned HMs: right-click to use your selected active ability, sneak + right-click to open the management GUI — select the quick-use HM, flip toggles, and drag to reorder.

## ⚙️ Fully configurable

Every ability's **hunger cost, cooldown and power** can be tuned via `/dittohm config` or the in-game config screen (Cloth Config, via Mod Menu on Fabric).
